import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import brentq
def T(tau,nu,N=40):
    s=np.sqrt(tau.imag)
    r=np.arange(-N,N+1)
    a,b=np.meshgrid(r,r)
    P=np.stack([(a+tau.real*b).ravel(),(tau.imag*b).ravel()],1)/s
    P=P[(a.ravel()!=0)|(b.ravel()!=0)]
    n=np.hypot(P[:,0],P[:,1]);m=n<9
    P=P[m];n=n[m]
    D=np.hypot(P[:,None,0]-P[None,:,0],P[:,None,1]-P[None,:,1])
    np.fill_diagonal(D,np.inf)
    return ((n[:,None]*n[None,:]*D)**-nu).sum()
h=np.exp(1j*np.pi/3);q=1j
for nu in [3,4,5,6,8,10]:
    print(nu,T(h,nu,15),T(q,nu,15), T(0.25+1j*np.sqrt(3)/2*1.0,nu,15))
